notes.title: Hentai Luna – Major Update Now Live! 🧩
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 💕

✨We’ve listened closely to your feedback, and with this major update, we’re taking the gameplay experience to a new level. Introducing an all-new puzzle level—designed to give you even more of a challenge and add to the excitement of unlocking exclusive scenes as you progress! 🧩

Here’s what’s new 🔥:

[list]
[*] Brand-new puzzle level: Explore more of the Hentai Luna world with fresh challenges waiting to be solved.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Performance improvements: We’ve optimized gameplay to ensure a smoother experience across the board.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Enhancements based on community feedback: We value your insights, so we’ve made updates to improve the overall quality and immersion of the game.
[/list]
With this major update, we’re also launching a Steam Visibility Round! If you haven’t stepped into the world of Hentai Luna yet, now’s the perfect time to join in! 🔥

Thank you for your support, and enjoy the game! 💕

notes.title: Big Hentai Gallery Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Big Update![/h1]

[h2]View solved level without solving it again[/h2]
Once you solve all the levels, you will be able to view them without solving again.

[h2]Performance improvements[/h2]
We made performance improvements based on your feedback.

[b]Thank you very much for your support![/b]
